remarks: Once in a while, a truly exceptional condo comes on the market-and this is one of them. Beautifully renovated with thoughtful, high-end finishes throughout, this remarkable residence welcomes you with elegance from the moment you step inside. The serene setting and sophisticated design evoke the feeling of a classic New York City apartment overlooking Central Park.Every detail has been meticulously updated, creating a move-in-ready home where all that's left to do is add your personal style and enjoy. The open-concept living and dining area offers outstanding flexibility for everyday living and entertaining. The spacious bedroom features an oversized closet, providing abundant storage. A private balcony offers you a relaxing outdoor space. New Luxury Vinyl Plank flooring has been installed throughout the condo and gives it a wonderful, seamless flow.A rare and desirable feature, this is one of the few units that allows you to enter directly from inside the building-no need to go outside to access your home. With exceptional craftsmanship and impeccable attention to detail throughout, this is a truly special opportunity not to be missed.
